groups.architect_note: The kernel's owners and their readers: plan_step owns "the step covering now" with its half-open end rule, read by the coordinator, the arbiter and both planned-room copies; water heat capacity, a naive instant's zone and the finite test get one definition each in const.py and drift.py; the two evidence-note methods share drift.py's owner. D7-s1-05 is kept here with its note and step arms; each other arm is carried by the group of the seam that owns the rule (entity-service, money, learners, actuation-release, inputs-freshness), and the finding closes when the last arm has merged. 3 findings (0 merged in), size M; class tags N-duplicated-rule, N-no-expiry, P2.

What the pure layer offers its importers: utc_elapsed_seconds is imported from drift.py, its owner, HISTORY_LENGTH moves to const.py, and currency.py imports HomeAssistant for its annotation only, so the pure modules that reached Home Assistant through accuracy.py and currency.py stop doing so. The reader's clock, the design ADR-002 part 2 gives four of the six modules D7-s1-06 left open, is carried by R11-SEAM-inputs-freshness in inputs.py; setpoint_check and snapshots stay. 1 finding (0 merged in), size S; class tags N-leaf-imports-solver.

groups.architect_note: State production stores and nothing reads (D7-s3-05): constants named only by tests, parameters a function never loads, locals, attributes and fields only tests read, each deleted in the module that holds it and at its callers, and the fourteen import bindings D7-s1-03 lists. No owner is created or moved and no behaviour changes, so this one group is cut by kind of edit and not by seam; COMPONENTS.md states the deviation. 1 finding (0 merged in), size M; class tags N-structure-blind.

Physical laws and the plant shape: the scalar Carnot factor agrees with its batch twin, delivery and derate keep their sign, and one predicate each answers "two zones", "modulating" and "has hot water" for the model, the plan views, the options page and the action. 11 findings (0 merged in), size L; class tags N-table-value, N-wrong-law, P2.

Every value entering through inputs.py is scaled once and tested finite and in domain: the minor-unit price scale, the Fahrenheit inverse, boolean and timestamp parsers, numeric options. The P1 sweep enumerator is the fitness function. 6 findings (0 merged in), size M; class tags N-missing-unit-scale, P1, P8.

Age and expiry of live inputs: a forecast that stopped advancing, a silent PV meter, forecast row 0 read as now, push-mode flags aged on a polling limit, and the measured outdoor value joining the forecast series. The end rule is the kernel's step owner, hence the edge from R11-SEAM-kernel-step. 7 findings (0 merged in), size M; class tags N-dead-input, N-no-expiry, N-staleness, P1, P2.

store.DOMAINS is the one schema: writers and loaders agree with it, non-finite leaves are quarantined, and a restored value is tested before it is applied. 5 findings (0 merged in), size M; class tags N-silent-zero, P1, P2.

Prices, fees, capacity windows and the ledger: whole-payload parse, weekday index, highest-window aggregate, scalar and batch top-k agreeing, open-window projection with a floor on settled time, one currency owner for the plan and the options dialog. 9 findings (0 merged in), size L; class tags I4, I5, N-inverted-aggregate, N-partial-payload-parse, N-partial-window-extrapolation, P2, P7, P8.

Start set brackets the all-off and wood-covered optima; the risk premium stays in the objective and out of every published money figure; the slot label tie is ordered. Fitness: D0 race harnesses, mutation kill rate on optimizer.py, shape_copies. 4 findings (0 merged in), size M; class tags N-objective-as-money, N-unordered-tiebreak, P4.

One freeze predicate owns which interval a learner may ingest (away, unplanned charge, load-limited probe, charge-start dip); the sysid adoption interval covers quantised readings. After the plant model: its law fixes move the residual every learner fits. 8 findings (0 merged in), size L; class tags I5, N-confounded-learner, N-event-misattribution, P5.

One restore owner for every entity the optimizer writes: supply switch, frequency, valve, circulation, mode and tank set-point are handed back on Off, stale plan, unload and remove, with a retried restore and a load that completes before the first read. 6 findings (0 merged in), size L; class tags N-order-coupling, N-restore-race, N-unreleased-hold.

What is written and when: every actuator reads the step covering now from the kernel owner, values sit on the entity's grid and range, a write to an unavailable entity is not recorded, the lead mode is checked against the entity. After release: both use the arbiter's held record. 9 findings (0 merged in), size L; class tags N-mode-coupled-write, N-stale-step-actuation, N-step-grid, P11, P2, P3.

The cycle owns when a solve runs: a write during an in-flight refresh arms a trailing run, every solve request shares one in-flight guard and budget, the worker's failure arms are bounded, and the action and the button reach one refresh path. 8 findings (0 merged in), size L; class tags N-dropped-refresh, N-solve-recompute, N-unbudgeted-background, N-uncleared-issue, P10, P2.

How a failure is reported: persist failures surface once above DEBUG, broad handlers leave a record, the generic arm is latched, an unparseable service argument raises, the context is write-once, the coordinator carries the typed entry and the strict-typing row is re-measured. 7 findings (0 merged in), size M; class tags I5, N-log-flood, N-shared-config, N-silent-zero, N-swallowed-failure.

One place for a setting: options-flow settings leave entry.data by a versioned migration, so reconfigure, the options save and the reader agree; the weekend value survives a weekday change; the pre-fill pages render their placeholders and store only settings. 6 findings (1 merged in), size L; class tags I4, N-dead-input, N-entry-data-placement, P2.

Published metadata and outcomes: state_class and device_class match the value, a refused press raises, availability and value share a predicate, selectors sit on their grid. D8-s2-02 changes no entity id without a registry migration. 8 findings (0 merged in), size M; class tags N-entity-metadata, N-name-sort, N-silent-zero, N-step-grid, P2.

Card: 24/44 px hit targets, the 12 px type floor, one colour per status role and type and spacing read from the token scales (card_rule_copies 70 at the fork may only fall), translated failure lines, bounded history rows. 9 findings (0 merged in), size L; class tags I4, N-unbounded-retention, N-untranslated-splice, P9.

User-facing strings state what the code does after this round's behaviour groups have merged; placeholders match across languages; copy style is one convention. Verified against the text ledger. 7 findings (1 merged in), size M; class tags I4, I5, N-copy-style.

What the suite exercises: a flow test follows each rendered error to its recovery, the coverage register row states the measured tier, the stress memory channel probes every scenario and one lane drives coordinator cycles. 4 findings (0 merged in), size L; class tags I1, I5.

Ratchet rows and barriers that see what they name: a rule written twice in one function, a package import nothing loads, and an unlatched .exception or .critical log site. Each new row is recorded at its measured value, after R11-SEAM-dead-state, whose deletions set the import row's value. 3 findings (0 merged in), size M; class tags N-log-flood, N-structure-blind.

The two rows whose value the owner sets: const fan-out read through a module binding (the corrected row reads 4 against a budget of 3) and module lines outside the class, whose limit the owner chooses. Cut from the other ratchet rows so the owner's confirmation holds only these two findings. 2 findings (0 merged in), size S; class tags N-structure-blind.
Reader docs carry each fact once and the number the code holds; verified last, after every user-facing change. 12 findings (1 merged in), size L; class tags I5, N-comment-style, N-orphan-doc.

Policy and programme prose with a false or unresolvable sentence. Policy files merge serially on the owner's approving review; no instrument code changes here. 10 findings (3 merged in), size M; class tags I4, I5, N-move-stale-path.
